summary:
Comprehensive Anti-Screen Capture & Recording Protection System:
- Full-screen blur and security shield activated immediately when window loses focus (e.g., when Snipping Tool, screen recorder, or screenshot hotkeys take OS focus)
- Keyboard capture interception for PrintScreen, Win+Shift+S, Cmd+Shift+3/4/5, and developer capture shortcuts, with clipboard clearing
- Security Shield Overlay with cyberpunk visual aesthetic and instant auto-restore on window refocus
- Global enforcement across the entire portfolio website without breaking legitimate user navigation
